question: Q-004
reason: Read theme.css, tokens.css and ToastRegion.tsx. .ui-button:hover sets background var(--ui-color-bg) (#ffffff) with specificity 0,2,0; .ui-toast button (0,1,1) sets color var(--ui-color-toast-text) (#ffffff) and transparent background, which the hover rule overrides. The Dismiss button has className ui-button, so on hover the label is white on white. shell.css has no button or hover rules that change this. The spec requires the theme to meet WCAG AA contrast, so the finding stands.

checked.claim: The hover rule for ui-button sets the background to the page background token with specificity 0,2,0.
The toast button rule has specificity 0,1,1, so its transparent background loses to the hover rule while its white text colour stays.
The hover background resolves to white.
The toast button text resolves to white, so hovered text is white on white.
The toast Dismiss button carries the ui-button class and so receives the hover rule.
